resources.string_add: Use the operator tools through MCP (AI assistants)
resources.string_upd: Connect AI assistants, such as Claude or ChatGPT, to your account. As an operator, your tokens also give them the operator tools switched on in Studio > Agents > Tools, which can change anything on the site. Make a token for each assistant, and revoke one to cut it off.
